appearance_facts.fact: A solid blue line with circular markers is present; its 2012 point is the second marker from the left, positioned at roughly y=260-270 pixels.
A dashed red line with square markers is present; its 2012 point is the second marker from the left, positioned near the bottom of the plot at roughly y=390-400 pixels.
A blue numeric label '89254' is printed above the blue line's 2014 marker.
A red numeric label '92207' is printed below the red line's 2014 marker.
A blue numeric label '89332' is printed above the blue line's 2018 marker.
A red numeric label '102807' is printed below the red line's 2018 marker.
The red dashed line rises steeply and remains above the blue line until the final 2021 point, where the blue marker reaches the top edge and the red marker is just below it.

printed_facts.fact: Blue axis label '0-19 years'; no numeric tick values are printed on this axis.
Red axis label '20-39 years'; no numeric tick values are printed on this axis.

public_definitions: Routing criterion: Larger 2012 age-cohort population shown in the dashboard.
uncertain: The 2012 markers for both series have no printed numeric labels, so the exact 2012 values are not directly readable.
The y-axes have no numeric tick values, so absolute population magnitudes cannot be read from the scale; comparison relies on marker height within the plot.
It is not stated whether the two series share the same y-scale or use separate left/right scales, which affects whether vertical position alone is a valid cross-series comparison.
